notes.title: My new game Loretta is available NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=78Kf2hOkOmI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Loretta is out! Hooray![/h1]

Loretta is a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes, leading her through a self-crafted nightmare. This story revolves around a woman handling betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, and reclaiming her agency during the socially tumultuous 1940s. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592540/Loretta/

I sincerely thank everyone who took part in the creation of this game, my friends, colleagues and each of YOU for continuing to follow my work!

I sincerely hope you enjoy Loretta as much as I enjoyed working on it. Please feel free to leave feedback, write comments, share it with friends and help others learn about our humble game, and, of course... play it! :)

And thanks to all!

Sincerely,

Yakov

notes.title: Loretta on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello!

My name is Yakov Butuzov, and I am an indie game developer. I would like to present to you a game that I have been working on - Loretta.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592540/Loretta/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/3f08723fd421824743446b5aaafaab10ace4c97a.png[/img]

Loretta is a psychological thriller that would make the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes and would lead her through a self-crafted nightmare.

This story is about a woman, dealing with betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, relationships problems and difficult social situation of the 1940s.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/1cf7fdafe7dcd322f23c3b046121a073e2a89145.gif[/img]

Conceptually and aesthetically, the game is inspired by the American art of the twentieth century, the works of Andrew Wyeth and Edward Hopper, film noir of the 40s-50s, thrillers by Alfred Hitchcock, the Philip Ridley movie "The Reflecting Skin", the books "1922" by Stephen King and "Lolita" by Vladimir Nabokov.

Loretta is a story-driven adventure game in which gameplay focuses on choosing phrases in dialogue, interacting with objects, and making decisions: planning the murder and getting rid of the evidence. 

Small teaser-trailer: https://youtu.be/ReWu9hMH1Es

I released my previous game DOM RUSALOK without a publisher, and got positive feedback from both journalists and players. Also, it gave me an opportunity to gather a small, but loyal audience.

Despite having studied epidemiology, I soon realized that I wish to dedicate my life to game development.

Thank you in advance! 

Sincerely,  

Yakov Butuzov

DOM RUSALOK is participating in a special sale dedicated to Maslenitsa!
I sincerely congratulate all of you.
Delicious pancakes for everyone, if not with caviar, then at least with sour cream!

I'am also started work on a new game, but I'm afraid it is still too early.
Here's a quick teaser:
[previewyoutube=ReWu9hMH1Es;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The year is 1947. Lora and Walter Harris move to a farm, which used to belong to his parents. Walter is a writer and Lora is an unemployed housewife. Both are quite unsuccessful.
The family is going through financial difficulties. The situation is also complicated by the fact that Walter owes money to people from New York. And although the husband keeps it a secret from his wife, Lora has a suspicion. Same as she suspects him of cheating.

Lora understands that she gave up her job, her dreams and other opportunities for her failure of a husband, she doesn’t even love. Now she is stuck in a cold empty house barely making ends meet.
As she struggles to make loan payments, she finds out that Walter’s publishing house has insured his life. In the event of his death or recognized as missing without trace, the insurance sum would be 30.000$. A plan is born in Lora’s mind.[/i]


But you can follow the development on my social networks if you wish:

notes.title: Provincial 90’s Russia - a space where no one can hear your scream.
notes.notes:
Hello,

My name is Yakov Butuzov, and I am an indie game developer from Russia. I would like to present to you a game that I have been working on for two years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/a6b59b661ec5e3440c1aff2e94bedc1376b9bada.png[/img]

Døm Rusalok – a horror-adventure game about childhood of post-soviet kids in 1990’s Russia; the story is set in a provincial town on the outskirts of the crumbling Soviet Empire. It is a story about children who come across a mystical horror, told through the lens of an era with a special kind of aesthetic of that time only.

Døm Rusalok – is a game about children confronted with a disturbing horror they are unable to comprehend. This is a story that follows the traditions of great works by Stephen King and Robert Stine. Only this time action does not take place in cozy suburban America, but at cellars, basements and yards of provincial 90’s Russia. The post-soviet Russian setting gives the game a unique atmosphere like no other. It creates a space where no one can hear your scream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/59d93f45c4c75adaa90e9ff4ba51d8a2dcc855bd.png[/img]

12-year-old Zhenya’s parents get divorced. He moves to his grandmother’s house for the summer break. Her house faces a big yard where many kids hang out. That is where Zhenya makes new friends.

They make friends, fight and reconcile, love and hate, but mostly just play. Life goes on as usual until one kid mysteriously goes missing, and the rest of the group has to face the DØM RUSALOK, an old barn of metaphysical nature. This is a place where the worst nightmares come true.

A number of challenges awaits the children who are about to discover the deepest darkest secrets hidden away in a human soul. A homicidal maniac is on the loose, while the street gangs thrive under the police protection. A cult with a TV psychic medium leader grows in popularity among the people. However, most importantly, at the heart of an abandoned research institute, which the town was originally built around, a somewhat chthonic power is about to awaken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/292a60f2e8e163a2c7afddf0adf19ef5b2d7a128.png[/img]

The main characters of Døm Rusalok are children. The action takes place during the summer of 1996. The story is told from a child’s perspective and shows how an average kid would experience all of the complex and conflicting events of that era.

There are four main playable characters. You can play as each character in their own separate storyline. All of the stories are interconnected. Zhenya, Dasha, Kesha, Lesha – four friends who have discovered something mysterious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37392446/db3bcf88ad09bdbed54731884188a111d597797c.jpg[/img]

Døm Rusalok is a plot-oriented point-and-click adventure horror game.

The mythical horror genre of the game provides the protagonists with encounters against threats, which sometimes are real, and other times – not so much. The story and the inner turmoil of children reflected through the gameplay are considered to be the key ideas behind this game.

The main goals we had during the developing stage of the game were to have a plot driven gameplay and to create an atmospheric world worth exploring.

My friends, Elena and Sergei, help me out with the animation and music aspects of the game.

The Russian version of the game is ready. At this very moment, we actively work on the translation of the game into the English language. It would presumably take a few months to finish. 

Please feel free to contact me if there is any problems with demo.

Thank you in advance!

Sincerely,

Yakov Butuzov.
